title: Healthcheck + Exec Deck Templates — Renewal Orchestration (Standard & Enterprise)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, copy-first deck template and supporting playbook for Renewal orchestration across two paths: Standard accounts (mid-market / self-serve growth) and Enterprise (multi-stakeholder, long-cycle). The goal: give CSMs a repeatable structure for a 45–60 minute customer-facing review plus the internal readout and the renewal sprint actions.

Notes to self (context):
- Built from patterns across >30 renewal cycles in 2024–25.
- Focus on outcome storytelling (impact, adoption, ROI) rather than raw logs.
- Keep slides skinny: data + 1 ask per slide.
- Enterprise variant includes stakeholder map, contract levers, and exec-level decision calendar.

Deck structure (slide-by-slide outline — copy into Google Slides):
1) Cover & Meeting Goals (1 slide)
   - Title: "Customer Name — Qx Renewal Review"
   - Subtitle: meeting objective (decide renewal / agree on next-phase scope / risk remediation)
   - Speaker note: "Start by confirming agenda and timebox; call out decision owner up-front."

2) One-line Impact Thesis (1 slide)
   - 2–3 bullets: top-line impact since last quarter (e.g., latency down 40%, inference unit cost -22%, embeddings accuracy increase)
   - Metric callouts: % adoption of routes, top 3 models in prod, estimated monthly spend delta.

3) Health Snapshot (1 slide, single table)
   - Dimensions: Usage (tokens, embeddings), Reliability (errors, p95 latency), Quality (regression checks failed/passed), Cost (unit cost trend)
   - Color-coded risk (green/amber/red) with 1-sentence remediation per amber/red.

4) Adoption Signals & Value Stories (1–2 slides)
   - Product flows using LLMs (chat, search, summarization).
   - Customer quotes / incidents that demonstrate value.
   - Speaker note: "Pick 2 wins that map to buyer persona KPIs (Growth/Support/Revenue)."

5) Regression / Quality Monitoring (Standard vs Enterprise variant)
   - Standard: show key prompt set pass rate and drift indicator.
   - Enterprise: include evaluation cadence, baseline, and flagged regressions with root-cause hypotheses.

6) Cost & Efficiency Summary (1 slide)
   - Show per-token cost trend, batching efficacy, and cache hit rate.
   - For Enterprise, overlay committed vs on-demand spend and forecast for next 12 months.

7) Risk & Roadmap (1 slide)
   - List top 3 risks with mitigation owner and dates.
   - Include short roadmap items relevant to renewal (e.g., dedicated capacity, private deployment pilot).

8) Ask & Renewal Recommendation (1 slide)
   - Present 2 options (renew baseline, renew + add-on, or wind-down) with clear financials and timelines.
   - Call out decision owner and expected decision date.

9) Delivery Plan & SLA / Contract Changes (Enterprise only)
   - Proposed SLA changes, data residency notes, P0/P1 support commitments and escalation path.

10) Action Tracker & Next Steps (1 slide)
   - Tabular view: Action | Owner | Due | Status | Notes. Keep 6 rows max for meeting.

11) Appendix (multiple slides)
   - Metrics deep dive (SQL snippets), change log of model rollout, logs of incidents, eval prompt sets.
   - Contact list and escalation matrix.

Standard vs Enterprise variant guidance (practical):
- Standard (mid-market): 30–45 minute meeting, focus on usage trends, quick wins, renewal recommendation framed as a simple 12-month commit. Keep slides minimal and deliver a one-page renewal quote after the meeting.
- Enterprise: 45–60+ minute meeting. Pre-read required 48 hours prior with health snapshot and proposal. Include legal/finance and technical stakeholders in meeting. Use decision calendar (below) and exec one-pager for procurement.

Decision Calendar (Enterprise) — sample cadence (copy into customer calendar):
- T-30 days: Internal exec sync (review ask)
- T-21 days: Send customer pre-read + commercial term sheet
- T-14 days: Technical deep dive (SRE/Infra)
- T-7 days: Final exec alignment and commercial negotiation
- Decision date: T-0.

Renewal sprint playbook (internal checklist — copy to CSM playbook tool):
- T-28: Create pre-read + internal risk score (0–100). Attach previous incidents and mitigations.
- T-24: Run renewal health SQLs; confirm data with Product Analytics.
- T-21: Send pre-read and draft commercial terms.
- T-14: Technical due-diligence meeting (SRE onsite/virtual).
- T-10: Collect legal/finance feedback; update terms.
- T-7: Exec alignment call; present final deck.
- T+2: Close loop, send contract and set onboarding + success milestones.

Risk scoring rubric (internal):
- Health score = weighted sum: Adoption (40%), Reliability (30%), Cost Trend (15%), Support Intensity (15%).
- Color bands: 80–100 green, 60–79 amber, <60 red.

Suggested SQL snippets (appendix — paste into BI query builder):
- Monthly active API keys (proxy for accounts):
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT api_key_id) AS active_keys, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE date >= date_trunc('month', current_date - interval '1 month') GROUP BY account_id;
- Response success / error rates by model:
  SELECT model, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='ok')::float/COUNT(*) AS success_rate FROM logs WHERE account_id = '{{account_id}}' AND timestamp >= '{{start}}' GROUP BY model ORDER BY success_rate ASC;

Customer-facing templates (snippets to copy):
- Pre-read email subject: "Pre-read: Renewal review & impact summary ({{Customer}})"
- Pre-read body (short): hi {{FirstName}}, attaching a 2-page snapshot we’ll walk through on {{date}}. Goal is to align on value, risks, and a recommended commercial path. Please share any additional stakeholders to invite.
- Exec ask email: "Decision required: Renewal proposal — {{Account}}"

Internal talking points (quick bullets for CSM):
- Lead with customer outcome: what changed for their users/business in last 90 days.
- Translate technical metrics to business outcomes (e.g., reduced time-to-answer -> support cost savings).
- Be explicit about tradeoffs (cost vs latency, batch vs real-time).

Appendix templates (copyable):
- 1-page exec summary template (bullet list): Situation, Impact, Recommendation, Ask, Next steps.
- 2-page technical appendix: Top KPIs, last 3 incidents, current model roster + versions, sandbox vs prod differences.
- Renewal quote template: Term, committed units, price/discount schedule, overage rates, support tier.

Outstanding questions & TODOs (internal):
- Confirm sample cost curve graphs from Finance (ask: Alex R.).
- Add automated export from Product Analytics into the pre-read (owner: Samir).
- Validate that Dedicated capacity pricing in the quote aligns with new 2026 pricing buckets.

Quick wins for this doc before finalize:
- Shorten appendix SQL section to 3 canonical queries.
- Add slide master with 2 pre-built chart placeholders (Health table, Cost trend).
